# LANDED — Gerrit change 1639 is MERGED (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1)

Evidence for AC6's out-of-repo half (the Gerrit vote requirement), read back from the Gerrit REST
API as `RebarBotNava`, not from memory:

```
GET /a/changes/1639/detail?o=LABELS&o=SUBMITTABLE
  status: NEW | submittable: True
  LLM-Review = approved
  Verified   = approved
  unresolved comments: 0

POST /a/changes/1639/submit
  status: MERGED | submitted: 2026-08-12 08:23:54
```

https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1639 → **MERGED**.

Gerrit is Rebase-If-Necessary, so it rebased server-side on submit: my local commit `e78dadb4be`
landed on Gerrit `main` as **`1791436c02` "Surface a failed tickets push to mute paths"**, parent
`671fa77c88`. (The GitHub mirror lagged at fetch time, which is why `origin/main` did not yet show
it; fetched from the `gerrit` remote instead.)

## AC verification re-run on the LANDED tree, not my local one

Worktree reset to `1791436c02`, then:

- **59 passed** — `test_push_pending_marker.py` (10), `test_mcp_push_status.py` (5),
  `test_mcp_output_schema_coverage.py` (36), `test_mcp_writes.py` (2),
  `test_push_rejection_surfacing.py` (6). AC1–AC5 and AC7 are asserted by these.
- `make lint` — **All checks passed** (ruff check + format, complexity baseline `new=0 increased=0`,
  zizmor, actionlint).
- `make typecheck` — **Success: no issues found in 506 source files**.
- MCP schema-drift gate — **OK, no missing declarations**.
- Module-size gate — cap 800; `push.py` **786** (it SHED `_unpushed_summary`, so this change made
  it smaller), `push_state.py` 220; the two largest files in `src/rebar` are unrelated
  (`_commands/init.py` 800, `llm/workflow/completion_banking.py` 799).
- `docs/mcp-reference.md` — regenerated, no drift.

Every acceptance criterion is met and its box is checked. AC6's in-repo half is verifiable from the
tree; its Gerrit-vote half is the transcript above and is tagged `[operator-attested]` accordingly,
since a vote on a review server cannot be evidenced from inside the repository.
